metadata.digitization: red line extraction, skeletonization, Douglas-Peucker simplification (1.2 px)

metadata.score_status: No per-road assessment scores were present in the PDF map image; all features remain unscored.
metadata.length_method: WGS84 geodesic length of the clipped digitized line; not a surveyed road length
